title: Computer Science
description: A program that focuses on computer theory, computing problems, and the design of computer systems and software, including algorithms, programming languages, data structures, operating systems, networks, and software engineering.

title: Computer and Information Sciences, General
description: A general program that covers computing fundamentals, information systems, software development, and the use of computers to solve problems in academic and applied settings.

title: Computer Engineering, General
description: A program that prepares individuals to apply mathematical and scientific principles to the design and development of computer hardware and software systems.

title: Management Science
description: A program that focuses on the application of quantitative modeling and analytical methods to organizational decision-making, operations, and management problems.
